models.author: Pedro B. Goulart (https://sketchfab.com/Pebegou)
models.title: Dino Fight
models.changes: Extracted Tyrannosaurus hierarchy from original Dino Fight scene; removed Stegosaurus and its animation. Mesh simplification ratio 0.7, error 0.001. Converted textures to WebP, maximum 2048px; original source/author/license extras preserved
